message.reasoning:
We need to produce test cases for exception scenarios not covered yet. Existing test cases already cover null versionFlag, unknown version flag, customizer throwing RuntimeException, customizer null, etc. Need to identify all possible exception scenarios in getInstance method.

Method:

public static JsonSchemaFactory getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag versionFlag, Consumer<JsonSchemaFactory.Builder> customizer) {
    JsonSchemaVersion jsonSchemaVersion = checkVersion(versionFlag);
    JsonMetaSchema metaSchema = jsonSchemaVersion.getInstance();
    JsonSchemaFactory.Builder builder = builder().defaultMetaSchemaIri(metaSchema.getIri()).metaSchema(metaSchema);
    if (customizer != null) {
        customizer.accept(builder);
    }
    return builder.build();
}

Potential exceptions:
- checkVersion may throw IllegalArgumentException if versionFlag null or unsupported.
- jsonSchemaVersion.getInstance() could throw NullPointerException? But likely not.
- builder().defaultMetaSchemaIri(...).metaSchema(metaSchema) could throw NullPointerException if metaSchema null (unlikely).
- customizer.accept(builder) could throw any RuntimeException (already covered with customizer throwing).
- builder.build() could throw IllegalArgumentException if metaSchema map contains duplicate IRI? Possibly if customizer adds a meta-schema with same IRI as default, causing duplicate? In builder.metaSchema adds to map with normalized IRI; if duplicate key, map.put will replace existing entry, not exception. So maybe not.

But there could be exception if customizer is null? Already covered: customizer null is fine.

Potential exception: customizer modifies builder to set null jsonMapper and later builder.build expects non-null? In Builder.build, it passes jsonMapper, yamlMapper, jsonNodeReader etc to JsonSchemaFactory constructor. That constructor may accept null values. Not sure.

Maybe exception when customizer passes null to builder.defaultMetaSchemaIri(null) - already covered but not exception.

Potential exception: customizer passes null to builder.metaSchema(null) causing NullPointerException inside metaSchema method (calls jsonMetaSchema.getIri()).

Yes builder.metaSchema expects non-null JsonMetaSchema; if null, NullPointerException.

Similarly builder.metaSchemas(null) collection? metaSchemas(Collection) will iterate over null -> NullPointerException.

builder.schemaLoaders(null) will cause NullPointerException when customizer tries to accept builder.schemaLoaders(null) as Consumer? Actually schemaLoaders method expects Consumer<SchemaLoaders.Builder>. If null passed, it will cause NullPointerException when customizer.accept(null) inside method? Wait method signature: public Builder schemaLoaders(Consumer<SchemaLoaders.Builder> schemaLoadersBuilderCustomizer) { if (this.schemaLoadersBuilder == null) { this.schemaLoadersBuilder = SchemaLoaders.builder(); } schemaLoadersBuilderCustomizer.accept(this.schemaLoadersBuilder); return this; } If passed null, calling schemaLoadersBuilderCustomizer.accept will throw NullPointerException.

Similarly schemaMappers(null) same.

Also builder.enableSchemaCache expects boolean; no exception.

Thus we can add test cases for customizer passing null to builder methods that expect non-null Consumer or JsonMetaSchema.

Also customizer could throw checked exception? Not.

Also checkVersion may throw IllegalArgumentException for unsupported version flag like UNKNOWN or maybe other values.

Already covered unknown. Null versionFlag is covered.

Potential exception: customizer modifies builder to set defaultMetaSchemaIri to empty string? Not exception.

Thus we need to add new test cases covering:

- customizer passes null JsonMetaSchema to metaSchema -> NullPointerException.
- customizer passes null collection to metaSchemas -> NullPointerException.
- customizer passes null Consumer to schemaLoaders -> NullPointerException.
- customizer passes null Consumer to schemaMappers -> NullPointerException.

Also maybe customizer passes null to metaSchemas(Consumer) that uses map -> NullPointerException inside customizer? That's covered by passing null consumer; but we can test that.

Also maybe customizer passes null to jsonNodeReader? builder.jsonNodeReader(null) allowed? It sets field to null; not exception.

Thus we produce test groups.

We must follow format: group name, cases array.

Each case includes input list of parameters: versionFlag and customizer (value representation maybe string description). Provide expected exception.

We'll produce JSON array.

Let's craft.

Group: "Customizer null argument handling"

Cases:

1. customizer adds null meta-schema via builder.metaSchema(null) -> expected NullPointerException.

2. customizer adds null collection via builder.metaSchemas((Collection)null) -> NullPointerException.

3. customizer calls builder.schemaLoaders(null) -> NullPointerException.

4. customizer calls builder.schemaMappers(null) -> NullPointerException.

Also maybe customizer passes null to metaSchemas(Consumer) itself: builder.metaSchemas(null) -> NullPointerException.

That's separate.

Thus group "Customizer passes null to builder methods".

We'll produce.

Make sure input customizer representation as string like "builder -> builder.metaSchema(null)". That's fine.

Now output JSON.
